headline: Shah Metacorp Limited: Allotment of Securities pursuant to Rights Issue
sum: Shah Metacorp Limited allotted 97,163,362 securities on 30 June 2026 pursuant to a rights issue. The allotment was approved at a board meeting and notified to NSE.
detail: Shah Metacorp Limited completed the allotment of approximately 97.16 million securities under a rights issue approved by its board on 30 June 2026. The allotment was intimated to NSE, triggering compliance with listing regulations for new share issuance. No acquisition or merger component is evident; this is a primary equity capital raise by the issuer itself. Settlement and trading of the allotted securities would follow exchange and SEBI protocols.
